decision_units.goal: 完成 Chapter 12.3：将现有 pre-commit 编辑后范围检查改造为只构造绑定当前 task/base/subject/Policy 的 hook_pre_commit scope_out_of_bounds immutable observation，并委派 12.2 共享 service 执行确定性审计、拒绝或单调升级；Hook 不复制 Policy/route 表、不直接写 event/state、不放行任何 observation decision，不实现 pre-command、CLI/CI parity 或 Policy/controlled-file 观察。
planned_actions: Preserve the existing explicit/unique active task resolution and full changed-path collection semantics
Convert only canonical out-of-scope paths into one immutable hook_pre_commit scope_out_of_bounds observation bound to current task/base/subject/Policy
Delegate the parsed observation exactly once to the existing apply_observation service with a fixed non-user-controlled Hook actor
Keep in-scope checks side-effect free and deny every out-of-scope result regardless of record, refuse or escalate disposition
Propagate task, Git, Policy, classification, state, audit and persistence failures through the existing fail-closed Hook error path
Add focused wrapper and real temporary-repository integration coverage for AUTO/REVIEW/BLOCK, replay idempotency and failure behavior
Project only Chapter 12.3 after implementation, formal verification and required review facts are current
